title: 10 Camden Buildings, Camden Street Lower, Dublin 2
seoTitle: 10 Camden Buildings, Camden Street Lower, Dublin 2
description:
Lovely old 2 bed mews house full of old world charm and character. Situated just off Camden Street, minutes from Stephen's Green and Harcourt Luas stop with a host of excellent cafes, delis, restaurants and bars on the doorstep. The house has a  cosy cottage atmosphere but is right in the city centre. If you are looking for something a little different from a standard apartment, this is it. Perfect city living. 

Downstairs consists of a lovely sitting-room with wooden floor and open fireplace, guest W.C., dining room with tiled flooring and dining table to seat up to 6, and a fully fitted kitchen with dishwasher and pyro-clean oven. A small utility area houses a washer dryer. Upstairs leads to 1 large double bedroom (4'6" bed) and 1 smaller double (4' bed), both with original old wooden floors and shower en-suites. Beds and mattresses in both bedrooms are new. Please note - there is no private outdoor space and no parking.

Strictly no smoking, no pets. 

Available to rent immediately. Rental from 2 months considered. References essential.
